mainEntity.name: Will my insurance cover storm damage, and how does the claims process work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most homeowners insurance policies cover sudden and accidental storm damage, but coverage details vary. Contact your insurer promptly to file a claim and understand your specific policy limits and deductibles. We can assist by providing detailed documentation, photos, and estimates to your insurance adjuster, which can help in streamlining the claims review process and securing appropriate compensation for repairs.
